youtube.baslik: What does writing Deaf with a capital D mean? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The word deaf, written with a lowercase d, describes an audiological condition: a severe loss of hearing; Deaf with a capital D is the cultural identity of people who use sign language and see themselves as part of the Deaf community. This spelling distinction was proposed in the early 1970s in the U.S. by the linguist Woodward. Turkish legislation mostly uses the term hearing impaired; if you do not know which word a person prefers, asking them is the most respectful way.
